neighbours.label: the digit after a decimal point in a small statistical figure ('0.8%', '1.3 billion') or a time comparison ('years earlier than expected'); weak guess
fire: Inflation rose by 2% last year, but only 0.6% came from food prices.
The unemployment rate fell from 5.1% to 4.9% over the summer months.
Of the 3% growth in exports, 0.7% was due to oil sales alone.
The bridge was finished nearly two years earlier than planned.
The birth rate dropped to 1.4 children per woman in that decade.
Only 0.3% of the samples showed any trace of the virus.
The project ended six months earlier than anyone had predicted.
Wages grew by 3%, of which 0.9% was eaten up by higher rents.
quiet: Inflation rose sharply last year, mostly because of food prices.
The unemployment rate fell steadily over the summer months.
Most of the growth in exports came from oil sales alone.
The bridge was finished after many years of careful work.
The birth rate dropped sharply in that decade across the country.
Only a few of the samples showed any trace of the virus.
The project ended in the autumn after a long delay.
Wages grew last year, but higher rents ate up much of the gain.

predictions: fire 0.2-0.3 on the decimal digit of figures like 0.6%; whole numbers below 0.1
notes: Card: peaks on ' earlier' in '20 years earlier than expected', '8' in '0.8%', ' seconds', '0' in years, ' low', '5' in '7.5 yards', ' tablespoon'; the opposite pole promotes ' larger', ' longer'.
